d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Romania vs Cameroon in Group K of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Romania claimed a 3-1 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Matei Padure, Eduardo Bodnar and Denis Aevoaei struck in a 15-minute spell after half-time, with Bassirou Nkoto pulling one back for Cameroon in stoppage time. Romania finish third in Group K, but both they and Cameroon exit the tournament.
